data.change_summary: Verified that the pending legacy kinetic `_mg` migration amendment is already satisfied in the current branch. `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs` still normalizes the renamed nitrogen-cycle Ks keys through `parse_process_params_preset()`, `crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs` still routes process loading through the parser-backed `load_parsed_validated_with_range_diagnostics()` helper, and the regression covering `aob_k_tan_mg = 200.0` -> `10.0 mg N/L` plus `param_meta` key migration is already present. No additional source edits were required in this turn.
outstanding_risks: Focused cargo validation is currently blocked by unrelated merge-conflict markers in `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs`, so I could not rerun `cargo test -p tank_data --lib` to reconfirm the process-loader regression in this worktree.

Callers that bypass the dedicated process preset parser/loader and deserialize legacy `_mg` process keys directly with serde still need to use the parser-backed path to preserve the 20 L normalization contract.

steps.description: Inspected the process preset parser and loader path to verify whether legacy kinetic `_mg` keys are still converted onto canonical concentration fields before validation and range checks.

Checked whether any source edits were still needed for the pending amendment; none were required because the current branch already contains the parser-backed loader helper, legacy-key normalization, and the regression coverage for the `aob_k_tan_mg` compatibility contract.
Attempted focused `tank_data` validation, then fell back to source-level verification when the build was blocked by an unrelated merge-conflict file in `tank_core`.

validation_evidence: `rg -n "load_parsed_validated_with_range_diagnostics|process_loader_migrates_legacy_kinetic_keys_before_range_checks|aob_k_tan_mg = 200\.0|Nitrogen-cycle Ks parameters" crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs` shows the parser-backed process loader helper in `crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs:198`, the legacy-key regression test in `crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs:380`, the exercised legacy key at `crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs:397`, and the normalization path comment in `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1263`.

`git diff --stat -- crates/tank_data/src/lib.rs crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs` returned no output, confirming no further source delta was necessary because the current branch already contains the amendment.

`cargo test -p tank_data --lib` failed before tests ran because `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs:205`, `:268`, and `:269` contain merge-conflict markers (`<<<<<<< Updated upstream`, `=======`, `>>>>>>> Stashed changes`), which is outside the scope of this provenance amendment.
`git status --short` showed no tracked-file deltas for this task; only unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` remains.
